useCases.problem: Buyers pay upfront and hope the seller delivers.
useCases.solution: Assurra holds the payment until the buyer confirms receipt.
useCases.outcome: Fewer disputes, more completed sales, happier customers.

useCases.problem: Clients vanish after payment, or freelancers work unpaid.
useCases.solution: Funds are held and released when the milestone or deliverable is approved.
useCases.outcome: Both parties stay protected through every stage of work.

useCases.problem: Suppliers demand prepayment for large orders.
useCases.solution: Corporate buyers fund an escrow that releases on confirmed delivery.
useCases.outcome: Large orders flow with shared trust and a full audit trail.

useCases.problem: High-value items bought online carry enormous fraud risk.
useCases.solution: The full amount is held in escrow until the buyer inspects and confirms.
useCases.outcome: High-ticket sales complete with protection on both sides.

useCases.problem: Platforms inherit the reputational damage of buyer-seller disputes.
useCases.solution: Embed Assurra via API so every transaction is escrow-protected.
useCases.outcome: Lower fraud, faster onboarding, and a safer marketplace brand.

useCases.problem: International buyers hesitate to prepay Nigerian sellers.
useCases.solution: Escrow provides the institutional trust buyers expect.
useCases.outcome: African sellers unlock export sales without prepayment barriers.
